verdict.rationale: NotebookLM lets researchers set scope before a run (select which sources the model uses) and choose depth/format (Deep Dive vs Brief vs Debate for Audio Overviews, custom persona/style for chat, FAQ/study-guide/briefing report types), and the probe notes distinct Fast Research vs Deep Research modes for gathering sources — all pre-execution steering knobs. However there is no evidence of steering effort or scope while a run is actively executing (mid-run adjustment), and community feedback focuses on other issues rather than confirming this granular control in practice. Missing for 10: evidence of live/mid-execution steering, and independent hands-on confirmation that Fast/Deep Research modes actually vary compute effort or scope as claimed.
